text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew... Alright.
choice_data_list: Last ten seconds, give it everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the Junior class, training and 
physical development 
were our top priorities... Following that 
plan, 
Daring Tact steadily continued putting in 
the quiet effort.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"—I saw your race the other day! 
You were awesome~! 
I can't believe you won against that 
field!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe~ Victory! 
And speaking of which, didn't you get 
interviewed too?! 
It really feels like we've made our debuts 
now~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm alright! 
Without rushing, steady and step by 
step... right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the break. 
Let us continue."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact was working extremely hard. 
Enduring the incrementally increasing 
load, she focused wholly 
on conditioning her body to bring out its 
full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During breaks and while walking between 
areas... 
I found myself catching her gazing blankly 
up into the trees more often.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list:
(She looks overheated. An ice pack 
should—)

(She looks overheated. I should get an ice 
pack—)

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Tact!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Here, please use this. 
It's nice and cold!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. 
I feel a little better now.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I'm glad I could help. 
You've been working so incredibly hard, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Your training intensity ramped up so much 
after your debut, didn't it? 
It's been quite inspiring to watch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn, you're... 
making your debut soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but it seems it'll take a little 
while longer. 
Think of it as taking my time to prepare 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: You too, Win Marilyn...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Well, they do say late bloomers make 
the greatest masters! 
The grander the vessel, the longer it 
takes to craft, after all.
choice_data_list:
(...She's trying to make Tact feel 
better.)

(...She's trying to make Tact feel 
better.)

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, speaking of the Tiara 
route! 
Tact, are you going to watch the Shuka 
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho is the final crown of the 
Triple Tiara. 
Held in late October every year, this 
year's race day was steadily approaching.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... I've been so 
focused on what's right in front of me, 
I haven't really considered it.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Really? What a shame! 
I'm sure this year will be more exciting 
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the path leading up to it 
has been intensely thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
With all eyes watching after Almond Eye 
became a Triple Tiara horsegirl last year—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho went to Gran Alegria, 
and the Oaks to Loves Only You. 
It's been a true clash of rivals up to 
this point.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
With neither of them running in this race, 
into whose hands will the final crown 
fall...?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
How will this incredible drama conclude?! 
Well, aren't you getting curious?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Um, Tore-san...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (murmur... chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what an immense crowd...! 
I wonder how many thousands of people are 
here.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thousands wouldn't even begin to 
cover it. 
I'd imagine around forty thousand gather 
every year.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Forty th-thousand...!? 
......

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Surely they aren't just from Kyoto. 
So many different people have come from 
all sorts of places.
choice_data_list:
All to witness the crowning of the final 
tiara...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait!" "Is it starting soon...?" 
"Ah, the fanfare's about to begin...!" 
"Whoa, it's finally here—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
W-whoa, the applause...! 
It's so loud...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...So this is a GⅠ race. 
Such staggering anticipation...!
choice_data_list: From here on—it gets even more incredible.
From here on—it gets even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose... I refuse to lose...!! 
If nothing else, this final crown... must 
be mine...!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (ROAAAAAR!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"GOOOOOOO!!" "Don't give up!!" 
"That's it, keep it up...!" "Aaaah...!!" 
"Go, go, go—WIIIIIN!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the winner is Chrono Genesis--!! 
Chrono Genesis claims the final crown!! 
A magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (CHEERING AND ROARING!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nearly forty thousand voices showering 
congratulations on a single horsegirl— 
it was a sight that could only be 
described as breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What... brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Next year... we might be 
standing on that very stage.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —No, we will be standing there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Amidst cheers so fierce they feel 
life-draining... 
running a race so intense it burns through 
life itself...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining it makes my heart race. 
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I can hardly wait! 
Doesn't it make your heart dance, Tact?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
A clash even fiercer than today's, moving 
the hearts of tens of thousands. 
...You and I together!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the starring role in that grand 
drama— 
will belong to me♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn... 
you truly are so dignified and confident.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To remain so completely unfazed, 
even in the face of such overwhelming 
fervor.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I've never felt that kind of intense 
energy before. 
It made me feel like I was swaying on my 
feet...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Can I really run in the middle of all 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be lacking confidence. 
Even though she had shown such unshakeable 
self-assurance back when we met in 
Hokkaido...
choice_data_list: (I want to help her catch her breath.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A place where she can truly relax... 
From watching her all this time, I 
understood to some extent. 
And that was—surrounded by nature.
